description: This file defines the ExceptionSerializationOptions class, which provides configuration options for exception serialization within the Orleans.Serialization namespace. It includes properties for supported namespace prefixes and a filter predicate for exception types.

classes.name: ExceptionSerializationOptions
classes.description: Provides configuration options for exception serialization, including supported namespace prefixes and a filter predicate for exception types.

methods.name: SupportedNamespacePrefixes
methods.description: A read-only property returning the set of namespace prefixes supported for exception serialization.

methods.name: SupportedExceptionTypeFilter
methods.description: A property that gets or sets the predicate function used to determine if an exception type should be serialized.
